summary: This bill requires the President's annual budget submission and the congressional budget resolution to include the ratio of the public debt to the estimated gross domestic product (GDP) and the ratio of the surplus or deficit to the estimated GDP.

scores.thoughts: This bill primarily focuses on increasing transparency regarding the national debt by requiring its ratio to GDP to be included in budget submissions. While it doesn't directly mandate debt reduction, it aims to highlight the issue, which aligns with prioritizing debt reduction through increased awareness.
